claude_proposed_widenings.name: MagicItemRecord + passive_while_worn mechanics family
claude_proposed_widenings.justification: The unit's kind is 'magic_item', which does not exist in the UnitRecord union (SpellRecord | ClassFeatureRecord | MasteryRecord). No MagicItemRecord type or associated mechanics family is defined in types.ts. The tracer's traceUnit switch has no 'magic_item' case and would throw 'unhandled unit kind: magic_item'. A MagicItemRecord must be added to UnitRecord, along with at least one magic-item mechanics family (e.g. passive_while_worn or spell_access_grant) to express items that grant spell access while equipped.
claude_proposed_widenings.evidence: While wearing this helm, you can cast Comprehend Languages from it.

claude_proposed_widenings.name: attunement flag on MagicItemRecord (optional, not required here)
claude_proposed_widenings.justification: Magic items in the SRD may or may not require attunement. This item does not (no 'Requires Attunement' tag), but a MagicItemRecord type must be able to represent both states without making attunement the default assumption. An optional 'requiresAttunement: boolean' field (or a separate 'attune' procedure branch) is needed at the record level.
